Name: Baby Brutes (Monster Toddler Replacement)
Author: lemonbitter
Description:
I made this sprite replacement for my own personal use, but I thought I'd upload it so others can enjoy it as well! It's just an adaption of an unused Shadow Brute sprite with some added animation to match the vanilla toddler. 

Currently this is Toddler stage only! I haven't finished the other stages, so for now you'll have to deal with a human baby until it ages up. At this point it is not compatible with any mods that also change the Toddler sprites. However, you can still delete either Toddler Girl or Toddler Boy from the content file, and then have one vanilla Toddler of the opposite gender. I do plan to make this mod a bit more polished eventually, ﻿but I am very inexperienced at modding in general, so I'll probably only add features that I'll use in my own gameplay. 

To install, simply unzip and add to your Mods folder. Please let me know if there are any issues!

Manifest.Description: Replaces Toddlers with custom Shadow Brutes.
